template: trade_when(greater(abs(group_zscore(winsorize(divide(ts_delta({value_08316q}, 63), ts_mean({value_08316q}, 252)), std=4), industry)), 1.5), group_zscore(winsorize(divide(ts_delta({value_08316q}, 63), ts_mean({value_08316q}, 252)), std=4), industry), 0)
idea: 极值区间择时（Tail-focused）。仅在利润率动量偏离行业均值超过1.5个标准差时产生信号，中段区间视为噪音并置零。通过trade_when实现"强信号开仓，弱信号观望"的机制，降低无效交易。
